The Department of Veterans Affairs National Acquisition Center (VA NAC) and the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Troop Support Solicitation for Radiology & Imaging Systems. 

This is a Draft RFP for contractor response and input only. The Government will not award a contract in response to the DRAFT RFP.

The Draft RFP is not an authorization to begin performance and in no way obligates the Government for any costs incurred by the contractor for this requirement. The Government will not award a contract in response to the subject DRAFT RFP. 

Potential Offerors are requested to respond to the DRAFT solicitation by July 25, 2025, 12 PM Central Time (CT). Offerors should use Attachment # 10   DRAFT Solicitation Question Matrix to provide any feedback, questions, comments, or concerns. Please submit to LaTonya L. Whiteside @ latonya.whiteside@va.gov. After receiving feedback, if deemed appropriate, the Government will update the Solicitation and supporting documents before releasing the official solicitation 36H79725R0003.
